<span class="hl-kw">from</span> __future__ <span class="hl-kw">import</span> annotations
<span class="hl-kw">from</span> typing <span class="hl-kw">import</span> <span class="hl-type">Any</span>
<span class="hl-kw">from</span> dataclasses <span class="hl-kw">import</span> dataclass


<span class="hl-comment">@dataclass(frozen=True)</span>
<span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData:
    lines: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]]
    matrix: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">float</span>]] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    untyped: <span class="hl-type">list</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    mixed: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-type">int</span>] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>

    @classmethod
    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> from_dict(<span class="hl-kw">cls</span>, data: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]) -&gt; UserCreatedData:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">cls</span>(
            lines=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;lines&quot;</span>),
            matrix=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;matrix&quot;</span>),
            untyped=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;untyped&quot;</span>),
            mixed=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;mixed&quot;</span>),
        )

    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> to_dict(<span class="hl-kw">self</span>) -&gt; <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> {
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;lines&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.lines,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;matrix&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.matrix,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;untyped&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.untyped,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;mixed&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.mixed,
        }
